info.name: Insights.Api Balancing Mechanism Dynamic Non-BM Volumes API

params.name: from
params.description: The "from" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: to
params.description: The "to" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: settlementPeriodFrom
params.description: The "from" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: settlementPeriodTo
params.description: The "to" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: bmUnit
params.description: The BM units to query. Add each unit separately. If no BM unit is selected all BM units will be displayed.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides balancing services volume data received from NGESO, with an added computed 'Time' field.
(The time field is calculated from the settlement date & period and represents the earliest possible time for
for which the datapoint applies)
            
Balancing services volume is a volume which is received from the System Operator, which represents the volume
of energy (MWh) associated with the provision of Applicable Balancing Services for each relevant BM Unit and
